stories.title: Decatur residents clash over proposed data-center campus
stories.dek: A heated debate in Decatur centers on how a large data-center project would affect property taxes, noise, and the local power grid. Neighbors worry about higher utility bills and water use while supporters point to promised jobs. The fight is shaping up as a test case for other small Michigan towns facing similar proposals.
stories.source_title: Data center debate rocks Decatur - The Center Square

stories.title: Detroit residents face blackout risk as groups demand data center freeze
stories.dek: Environmental advocates are urging Detroit to halt new data center projects while the city writes rules on power and water use. The push comes as hyperscale builds threaten to strain the grid and raise costs for households. A moratorium would give time to assess impacts on ratepayers and neighborhoods.
stories.source_title: Environmental groups call for Detroit data center moratorium as city develops ordinance - planetdetroit.org

stories.title: Mike Rogers pushes statewide pause on new data center construction
stories.dek: The Republican Senate candidate wants Michigan to stop approving data centers until utilities prove they can handle the load without hiking bills. The call targets projects that could add thousands of megawatts of demand in coming years. Voters in both parties have voiced concern over who pays for the upgrades.
stories.source_title: Republican Senate nominee in Michigan former Rep. Mike Rogers calls for temporary data center construction pause - foxnews.com

stories.title: Ypsilanti weighs year-long halt on new data centers
stories.dek: City leaders will debate a temporary ban on standalone data center proposals at tonight's council meeting. Residents fear the projects would spike electricity rates and strain the local water supply. A moratorium would give Ypsilanti time to craft permanent zoning rules before any large facilities arrive.
stories.source_title: Ypsilanti City Council set to address potential moratorium on data centers - WEMU

stories.title: Vance links data centers to Michigan power bills and jobs
stories.dek: The vice-presidential candidate used his Sterling Heights stop to frame data center growth as both an economic opportunity and a risk to utility costs. He tied the issue to University of Michigan research and trucking impacts. Michigan voters heard how new facilities could affect household bills across the state.
stories.source_title: U-M, truckers and data centers: 3 takeaways from JD Vance’s Michigan visit - MLive.com

stories.title: Closed-door data center pitch raises electric bill, water fears for nearby residents
stories.dek: Officials from across the region sat through pitches on new data center projects while demonstrators rallied outside. Residents 30 miles away could soon face higher electric bills and water strain if the proposals advance. The closed-door format left many locals wondering whose voices are shaping the deals.
stories.source_title: Private data center seminar attended by 100+ West Michigan officials, protesters outside - WWMT

stories.title: West Michigan Officials Attend Closed Data Center Seminar Amid Protests in Dorr Township
stories.dek: More than 100 municipal leaders from Allegan, Barry and Kent counties gathered for an invite-only session on zoning and inspections hosted by a private firm, while dozens of residents protested outside over concerns about water use and a Microsoft proposal under moratorium until 2027.

stories.title: Data center faces new township hearing amid resident worries over grid, roads
stories.dek: The data-center developer is scheduled to appear again before Lyon Township planners next month. Residents in this Oakland County community have already raised concerns over power demand and local impact. The project could bring major construction but also strain on the grid and roads.
stories.source_title: Project Flex Developer to Go Back Before Lyon Township Planners in September - WHMI

stories.title: Construction milestone raises local fears over power bills, water at AI facility
stories.dek: The massive project near Ann Arbor has now reached a million construction hours. Washtenaw County residents are watching how the facility will affect electricity rates and water use once it ramps up. Local jobs are growing, but so are questions about long-term costs to taxpayers.
stories.source_title: OpenAI data center project south of Ann Arbor hits 1 million work hours - MLive.com

stories.title: Saline Township's 'The Barn' data center rises fast on farmland
stories.dek: Construction of the large project nicknamed The Barn is advancing rapidly in Saline Township. Nearby residents will see new power lines, traffic and potential tax shifts as the facility comes online. Washtenaw County communities are watching how quickly the buildout changes local land use and utility demands.
stories.source_title: Saline Twp. Data Center Project, aka 'The Barn' going up quickly - The Detroit News

stories.title: Michigan lets data center firms hide tax breaks from public view
stories.dek: State law allows tech companies to keep details of data center tax incentives secret from residents and local officials. This reduces transparency on how much revenue cities and townships lose when large projects win abatements. Michigan readers 30 miles away feel the impact through higher local taxes or strained services when big facilities arrive.
stories.source_title: Tech giants can shroud Michigan data center tax incentives in secrecy - The Detroit News

national.title: Data centers advance rapidly as regulators scramble for rules
national.dek: Across the U.S., officials race to impose guardrails on power-hungry facilities while communities push back on incentives and impacts.
